title: Resolving the Interstellar Medium in the Nuclear Region of Two z = 5.78 Quasar Host Galaxies with ALMA
question: How are [CII] and dust emission distributed and how does the gas move on kpc scales in two z=5.78 quasar hosts, and what do they imply for [CII]-FIR deficit and host dynamical mass?

data.sensitivity: Cube rms 0.20 (J0129) and 0.36 (J1044) mJy/beam per 17 km/s; continuum rms 21 and 40 uJy/beam

what.value: ALMA Cycle 0 data, [CII] redshifts, FIR luminosities (T=47 K, beta=1.6), Cycle 0 fluxes

evidence.quote: $\rm L_{FIR}$ is the FIR luminosity derived in (cite: wang13) assuming dust temperature of 47 K and emissivity index of $\rm \beta=1.6$

what.value: ULAS J1319+0950 [CII] and continuum data for comparison

evidence.quote: We also include ULAS J1319+0950 in the comparison

what.value: Comparison samples (GOALS, SMGs, LBGs, quasars) for [CII]-FIR vs surface brightness

evidence.quote: We collect samples of star forming galaxies and quasars at low and high redshifts that have continuum source size measurements from ALMA

what.value: CO(6-5) spectra of J0129 and J1044

evidence.quote: compared to the CO (6-5) line spectrum published in Wang et al. (2011)

recipe.method: Combine Cycle 0 and Cycle 1 uv-data, subtract pseudo-continuum, clean with robust=0.5
Integrate within 2 sigma contour; elliptical Gaussian fits in image and uv planes

recipe.goal: Radial [CII] and FIR surface brightness profiles
recipe.method: Scale continuum map by L_FIR/S_con; mean in 0.1'' rings; fit beam-convolved exponential disk (n=1)

recipe.goal: Fit disk rotation to J0129 velocity map and derive dynamical mass
recipe.method: ROTCUR circular rotating disk fit within 0.35''; M_dyn from V_c at 1.8 kpc
key_parameters: Disk centre fixed at [CII] Gaussian peak; V_sys=0; radius 0.35''

evidence.quote: we derive the dynamical mass within a radius of 1.8 kpc to be $\rm M_{dyn}=2.6\times10^{10}\,M_{\odot}$
the circular velocity at the largest radius (i.e., 1.8 kpc) is $\rm V_c$=250 $\rm km\,s^{-1}$
1.8$\pm$0.2 and 2.6$\pm$0.5 times larger than that of the continuum
yields a FWHM line width of $\rm 750\pm190\,km\,s^{-1}$

not_stated_but_needed: CLEAN parameters: cell size, image size, masks, thresholds, iterations, deconvolver
Line-free channel ranges and channels used for line moment maps
Moment-map thresholds for J0129 (J1044 uses >4 sigma)
Weight-correction details and exact Cycle 0 calibration state
Ring/pixel handling and fitting details for exponential disk surface-brightness model
ROTCUR ring widths, fixed parameters and initial guesses
Gaussian fit method for J1044 spectra
score_reason: Public data and clear outline, but imaging and fitting parameters are incomplete.
rediscovery_reason: Public data, numeric results (fluxes, sizes, inclination, M_dyn) can be redone.
